title: Introduction to Machine Learning
description: Learn the fundamentals of machine learning algorithms, including supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
overview: This lesson provides a comprehensive introduction to machine learning, covering fundamental concepts, algorithms, and practical applications. Students will gain hands-on experience with supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
learningObjectives: Understand the basic concepts and terminology of machine learning
Differentiate between supervised and unsupervised learning
Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics
